citation.title: Topological dimensionality reduction-based machine learning for efficient gradient-free 3D topology optimization
citation.authors: Zhaoyou Sun, Yaguang Wang, Pai Liu, Yangjun Luo
citation.version_coded: Abstract only; ScienceDirect page and PDF returned HTTP 403

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract says DNN-MFSE cuts computation time by 1–4 orders of magnitude versus coarse-mesh gradient-free methods.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: The abstract states a range of 1–4 orders of magnitude but this is not a single factor; the underlying runtime values are unavailable without full text.
claim.alternatives: The abstract reports an optimized cellular material bulk modulus reaching 98% of the Hashin–Shtrikman bound and a 16.59% decrease in peak weld stress.

baseline.problem_size: 3D topology optimization; thousands of finite elements (abstract)
baseline.quality_metric: Effective bulk modulus relative to Hashin–Shtrikman bound; peak weld stress (abstract)
baseline.quality_gap: Bulk modulus reaches 98% of the theoretical bound; peak weld stress decreases 16.59% in phone drop process (abstract).

reporting.n_test_cases: Several design problems (abstract; count not stated)

notes: The publisher page and abstract are readable, but its PDF was blocked (HTTP 403); searches did not identify a legitimate open repository copy. The inclusion reason and primary outcome are therefore abstract-only.
